worldcombat.skill.poweruppunch.summary: A short straight punch: the jab itself is light, but every hit hardens the user's fist by one Attack stage (two with Wound Up), so each landed punch makes the next one heavier. The value is the ramp, not the single blow.
worldcombat.skill.poweruppunch.use.0: Open with a reliable jab to start the Attack ramp
worldcombat.skill.poweruppunch.use.1: Stand close and keep punching one target, heavier each time
worldcombat.skill.poweruppunch.use.2: Max the Attack stage early in a fight, then switch to heavier moves
worldcombat.skill.poweruppunch.descripti: The straight punch deals about %1$s Fighting contact and punch damage, reaching %2$s blocks with a %3$s block fist radius; the target's Defence, type matchup and crits are settled on impact.

Each landed hit raises the user's Attack by up to %1$s stage (capped at +6) and refreshes the Hardened Fist window for %2$s (every hit within it renews it); the fist shoves the target about %3$s blocks. When the window expires, is cured or is refreshed, only the stages this move raised are withdrawn; Attack from elsewhere is untouched.
worldcombat.skill.poweruppunch.charge.on: Wound Up: a longer wind-up and a 20 percent lighter jab, but each hit hardens 2 stages, the window lasts 40 percent longer and the cooldown is 20 percent shorter: time traded for a steeper ramp.
worldcombat.skill.poweruppunch.charge.of: Quick Jabs: faster and 12 percent heavier per punch, but only 1 stage per hit, with a shorter window and a longer cooldown: ramp traded for immediate value.
worldcombat.skill.poweruppunch.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.poweruppunch.growth.0: From level %1$s the jab rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.poweruppunch.growth.1: From level %1$s the jab rises to %2$s and the hardened window to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.poweruppunch.preferenc: On: preparation x1.9 and jab x0.8, but each hit hardens 2 stages, the window is x1.4 and the cooldown x0.8. Off (Quick Jabs): jab x1.12, 1 stage per hit, normal window and cooldown.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of punching. The reach is short, so a large value often still cannot connect.
On: keep punching to hold the Hardened Fist window even when it is already up; off: hand the turn back to the shared plan for heavier moves.
